headline: Axiom-Tessera Border Clash Leaves 14 Dead in The Circuit
body:
A coordinated paramilitary incursion along the Axiom-Tessera contested boundary at Grid 7-North in The Circuit has left 14 dead and over 60 wounded, marking the bloodiest territorial dispute between the two corponations in nearly a decade. Axiom's corporate security arm, Black Lattice, deployed armored drones and suppression units at 0340 hours, striking three Tessera-licensed data exchange nodes before Tessera's own Vanguard Response teams returned fire. The exchange lasted approximately 22 minutes before both parties retreated to their respective perimeter lines. Meridian Emergency Services was denied access to the scene for nearly four hours, a delay city officials are now demanding answers on.

Eyewitnesses in the surrounding commercial block describe scenes of chaos as automated turrets cross-fired across a crowded pedestrian corridor. 'The storefronts just went dark all at once �� then the shooting started,' said Amara Johanssen-Liang, a vendor whose stall was destroyed in the firefight. 'Nobody warned anyone. Nobody cares about us out here.' At least three of the dead have been identified as civilian bystanders with no corporate affiliation.

The Federal Remnant's Meridian Oversight Office issued a formal rebuke within the hour, calling the engagement 'an unconscionable violation of the Shared Urban Sovereignty Accords of 2189.' Axiom's communications division responded with a terse statement accusing Tessera of 'systematic encroachment on licensed infrastructure' without providing evidence. Tessera has not publicly commented as of broadcast time.

Analysts warn this may be the opening move in a prolonged campaign. Zheng-Dao, which holds lease agreements with both corponations along the Grid 7 corridor, has reportedly convened an emergency board session, raising fears that the conflict could draw in a third major power and destabilize the entire Circuit commercial zone.
aftermath: Axiom and Tessera entered closed-door arbitration under Zheng-Dao mediation three weeks later, but low-level skirmishes continued along Grid 7-North for the remainder of 2198, displacing over 800 small-business operators.
runner_relevance: The contested no-man's-land between Axiom and Tessera perimeters became a live runner market almost overnight. Tessera contracted extraction teams to pull stranded data couriers from inside Axiom-controlled blocks, while Axiom quietly hired sabotage runners to destroy Tessera relay nodes before arbitration could catalog them as evidence. Neutral smuggling contracts through the corridor tripled in price as legitimate freight routes collapsed — Bore Rats started running critical supply packages through Underworld tunnels beneath Grid 7 for a premium, and Graycloaks began brokering intelligence on troop movements to any faction willing to pay, spawning a secondary market for counter-intelligence runners hired to find and silence them.
